items.title: 21.11 Global climate and energy transfer from the Sun (Sooraj se energy ka aana aur duniya ka climate) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of global climate and energy transfer from the Sun (PDF 179-181).

blocks.text: Sooraj se milne wali energy duniya ke climate mein tabdeeliyan lane mein aham kirdar ada karti hai. Yahan hum mukhtasar dekhenge ke Sooraj ki energy zameen par kaise distribute hoti hai (phailti hai), aur equator aur poles ke darmiyan barabar garmi na hone (uneven heating) se atmosphere (hawa) mein kaise tabdeeliyan aati hain.
